facts.fact: Lei n.º 3/21, promulgated on 12 January 2021 and in force on publication, amends Lei n.º 4/09 on the legal regime of civil identification and issue of the national citizen identity card (an act of the National Assembly).

facts.fact: The amended Lei n.º 4/09 (article 9) gives each identity card a number that acts in law as the Número Único do Cidadão (NUC), an identity number unique to each citizen, and the card carries an encrypted QR code in the photo band.

facts.fact: Lei n.º 20/17, promulgated on 9 August 2017 and in force on publication, amends articles 8, 20 and 52 of Lei n.º 4/09 on the legal regime of civil identification and issue of the national citizen identity card (an act of the National Assembly).
facts.system: Lei n.º 4/09 (Regime Jurídico da Identificação Civil e Emissão do Bilhete de Identidade de Cidadão Nacional), as amended by Lei n.º 20/17

facts.fact: The amended article 8 of Lei n.º 4/09 has the identity card carry a data-storage microprocessor holding the visible identifying data and non-visible items such as tax, social security, birth-record and voter numbers, so that the card can interact with public and private institutions.

facts.fact: RNA reports that the Government's Proposta de Lei da Identificacao Civil e Criminal, which makes the Bilhete de Identidade the only valid document for personal identification, was discussed on 26 October 2026 in the National Assembly's specialised committees.

facts.fact: Angola's National Assembly approved in detail on 30 October 2026 chapters III and IV of the Proposta de Lei de Identificacao Civil e Criminal, so the bill is still before parliament.
facts.system: Proposta de Lei de Identificacao Civil e Criminal

note: The chapters voted cover the criminal record and special registers; nothing on a digital identity.

facts.fact: Novo Jornal reports that the National Assembly's committees have been discussing the Civil and Criminal Identification bill (Proposta de Lei da Identificacao Civil e Criminal) in committee stage since 29 October 2026; it makes the Bilhete de Identidade the sole valid and mandatory citizen ID.
